intro: Lesson 80: Geometry: similar shapes: length, area and volume. Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: (a) Similar cones: heights 6 cm and 9 cm; small volume 48 cm³: large volume [3] (b) Similar bottles: surface areas 150 cm² and 337.5 cm²: ratio of heights [3] (c) Similar solids: volumes 54 cm³ and 250 cm³; the large height is 15 cm: small height [3] (d) A triangle with sides 5, 7, 9 is enlarged so its area is 4 times as big: new longest side [3]
A solid has mass 2.4 kg. A similar solid made of the same material has a surface area 9 times as large. Find its mass.
Two similar cylinders have radii 4 cm and 6 cm. The small one has volume 128 cm³. Find the large volume.
Similar triangles have areas 18 cm² and 50 cm². A side of the small one is 6 cm. Find the matching side.
A map is 1 : 50 000. A lake is 3 cm² on the map. Real area in km²?

questions.a: No: half the height gives 1/8 of the volume.
